observed: Both supplied cans sit in both Plate A openings at once (owner-observed mating; owner-confirmed assembly context).
The board lies behind the wall, front face toward the wall inner face; the cans project forward through the openings by about 10 mm past the wall outer face.
The crystal sits inside the deck-side slot; the crystal edge of the board is the edge toward the deck (installed up).
The 4-pin connector is on the board's rear face at the edge away from the deck, and its housing projects past the wall's free edge (installed down). Connector-down is now observed, not inferred.
The board's ends lie inside the two wall end holes, so the rivets pass beside the module.
Rear components (three SOIC packages, passives, transducer pins) stand proud of the board's rear face over most of the area Plate H would cover.

V40 S08 (locked PDF page 2, sha256 2f4ea3ae3729bfb6bc92f8fdba30f31937f9df2c3a80e5774ef03fb076f386ce) draws the pan servo arm under the deck, across the car, directly behind the wall and visible through the deck-side slot; V40 S09 draws the arm's splined hub above the module's top region. Neither panel shows Plate H's notch.
